Name: Aspect of Mortuous
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
Mortuous has almost no interest in incarnating in the Material Plane, and rarely involves himself in conflicts with other deities. He watches over mortals in an endless search for entertainment, hoping to find powerful warriors who he can silently refine and challenge, aiming to eventually pit them against the warriors who live eternally within his own divine realm. Warriors who impress Mortuous and defeat his challenges earn a place after death in his divine realm - the Warscored Empire.

When Mortuous finds a combatant he feels is worthy of battling, he will have one of his associates guide them down the path of glory and success. Then, at their highest peak, he will challenge them to one of his competitions (usually gladiatorial in nature) within one of the many demiplanes he creates for this purpose. His aspect most commonly appears in these demiplanes to watch over the battles, but on occasion Mortuous has been willing to accept challengers directly.

**ASPECT OF MORTUOUS**
*Large humanoid (dragonkin), chaotic good*
**Armor Class** 18 (natural armor) **Threshold** 10
**Hit Points** 345 (30d10 + 180)
**Speed** 40 ft.
**Quality Traits** Adamant hide, deific, magic resist
**STR** 28 (+9) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 22 (+6) | **INT** 15 (+2) | **WIS** 17 (+3) | **CHA** 18 (+4)
**Saving Throws** Dex +10, Int +10, Wis +11, Cha +12
**Skills** Athletics +17, Intimidation +12, Perception +11
**Resistances** B/S/P (adamantine)
**Immunities** B/S/P (magical)
**Condition Immunities** charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed
**Senses** blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 21
**Languages** all
**Challenge Rating** 25 (75,000 XP) **Proficiency Bonus** +8

***Innate Spellcasting.*** Mortuous’ spellcasting ability is Charisma. He can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• ***1/Day each:*** incineration tower, mass command, minor gate, shockwave, supreme hand
• ***2/Day each:*** dimension door, force missile
• ***3/Day each:*** friend as foe, weapon of domination

Mortuous’ spells are cast at 6th level, unless their base level would be higher.

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS (3 USES)**
TBA.

***Ultimate Entertainment (Mythic Awakening).*** When Mortuous would be reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, his hit points reset to 300, and he regains all his spent uses of Legendary Resistance and any spells he has used through his Innate Spellcasting. For the next hour he can use his Mythic Actions, his movement speed doubles, and his attacks score a critical hit on a d20 result of 18, 19, or 20. A party who defeats Mortuous after using Ultimate Entertainment is awarded an additional 75,000 XP (for a total of 150,000 XP).

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** Mortuous uses his Slam three times, then one of the following options: Champion’s Lance once; War Javelin once; Mortuous casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action.

***Champion’s Lance.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. *Hit:* 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage plus 33 (6d10) force damage.

***Slam.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +17 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* (3d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

***War Javelin.*** Mortuous hurls a javelin of energy into the air, which splits and rains down on up to three targets Mortuous chooses within 60 feet. Each is a *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +17 to hit. Each creature hit takes 22 (4d10) force damage.

***Mythic Action: Cratering Strike (Recharge 6).*** Mortuous strikes the ground under his feet, causing a shockwave to erupt and strike each creature within 30 feet of him. Each target must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw, taking 87 (14d10 + 10) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Each creature that fails is also knocked back 15 feet and falls prone.

**REACTIONS**
***Reckless Assault.*** When Mortuous misses a weapon attack, he can roll another d20 and use it in place of the existing result. Then, until the end of that turn, he has advantage on each attack he makes. Until the start of his next turn, other creatures have advantage on attacks against him as well.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (4 ACTIONS)**
***Grapple.*** Mortuous makes a grapple attempt against a creature within 5 feet of him. If he wins, he can choose one of two options: the target is grappled and restrained (escape DC 26), or Mortuous can throw the creature into an unoccupied space within 40 feet, where they take 18 (4d8) bludgeoning damage and fall prone.

***Challenge Rush (Costs 2 Actions).*** Mortuous moves up to 60 feet toward an unoccupied space he can see, then makes a single Slam attack with advantage. This movement is not reduced by moving through the spaces of other creatures.

**MYTHIC ACTIONS**
Mortuous can use the following as Legendary Action options for 1 hour after activating his Mythic Awakening.

***Trust in One’s Hide (Costs 2 Actions).*** Mortuous gains 46 (4d12 + 20) temporary hit points as his skin hardens further. While he has these temporary hit points, any creature who hits him with a weapon attack from within 5 feet is hit with a wave of pure energy, taking 2d8 force damage.

***Enraged Alter (Costs 3 Actions).*** Three 15-foot tall, 5-foot radius columns appear at different points Mortuous chooses within 60 feet. Each column is covered in reliefs of Mortuous’ greatest victories. Creatures hostile to Mortuous have disadvantage on attack rolls made within 15 feet of these pillars due to them supernaturally drawing the creature’s attention. Each pillar has resistance to piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning damage, immunity to necrotic damage, and 15 AC. They only break if they take 15 points of damage or more from a single attack.
